title: PHP Readies Critical Security Updates to Patch Another RCE Flaw
description: CVE-2026-115560 is a critical remote code execution vulnerability in PHP's session upload progress feature. It requires a rare configuration involving session.serialize_handler settings and session upload progress enabled. The flaw was publicly disclosed shortly after PHP2Shell vulnerabilities were patched. PHP plans to release official patches as part of its regular update cycle. Users are advised to disable session upload progress as a temporary mitigation and prepare to upgrade promptly once fixes are available.
